import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int[] input = read(scanner);
        int height = input[0];
        int number = input[1];
        number -= 1;
        String binStr = Integer.toBinaryString(number);
        binStr = "0".repeat(height - binStr.length()) + binStr;

        StringBuilder outputStr = new StringBuilder();
        for (int position = 0; position < height; position++) {
            if (position != 0 && binStr.charAt(position - 1) == '0') {
                outputStr.append(binStr.charAt(position) == '0' ? '1' : '0');
            } else {
                outputStr.append(binStr.charAt(position));
            }
        }

        long totalSum = 0;
        for (int position = 0; position < height; position++) {
            totalSum += 1;
            if (outputStr.charAt(position) == '1') {
                totalSum += Math.pow(2, height - position) - 1;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(totalSum);
        scanner.close();
    }

    private static int[] read(Scanner scanner) {
        String lineInput = scanner.nextLine().trim();
        String[] parts = lineInput.split("\\s+");
        int[] result = new int[2];
        result[0] = Integer.parseInt(parts[0]);
        result[1] = Integer.parseInt(parts[1]);
        return result;
    }
}
